title: Classify custom emoji as retained shared household content
owner_decision: Delete live private user data; do not delete shared household records merely because a departing user authored or uploaded them.
classification: Intentional shared-record retention under ADR 0013. The initial candidate interpretation as user-owned content conflicted with the accepted policy and has been corrected.

disposition.row: Retain the CustomEmoji row because household users share the resource.
disposition.file: Retain the image file with the shared row.
disposition.uploader: The existing users foreign key uses ON DELETE SET NULL, so the uploader identity is removed when the user row is deleted.

verification.result: passed: 6 tests on Python 3.14.10 and PostgreSQL 17.6
verification.assertions: After deletion, the custom emoji row remains, uploaded_by_user_id is NULL, and the shared image file remains. The same run verifies retained chat history, audit redaction, duplicate-log redaction, owned-file cleanup and FK inventory.

limits: This disposition applies to the shared household emoji resource and does not change cancellation cleanup for an upload whose request is cancelled before acceptance.
The full retained-record text review and deployed-schema comparison remain open.
